title: What is it to Wake Up and Be Here Together?
speaker: Hoka Chris Fortin
summary: The talk's main teaching is that true transformation happens when we embody awareness and compassion in our daily lives, rather than just trying to achieve a specific state or feeling. By cultivating mindfulness and embracing the full range of human experience, including pain and joy, we can find freedom from suffering and develop deep love and connection with ourselves and others. This involves recognizing our interconnectedness with the world and living in harmony with it, rather than trying to separate ourselves from it.
